title: roegneria yangiae
intro: Roegneria yangiae, commonly known as Yang's wheat grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. It is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Roegneria yangiae include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
